purpose: request separately authenticated privileged helper to perform one allowlisted service action.

source.source_text: Purpose: request separately authenticated privileged helper to perform one allowlisted service action. Input: service_id:string, action:start|stop|restart|enable|disable, expected_state?:string. Output: pre-state, action result, post-state verification. Contract: L5 privileged; scope mac.priv.service; target service_id; timeout 30000ms; cap 256KiB; no generic command string; helper allowlist and caller authentication mandatory; approval explicit_privileged_policy; non-idempotent except state-setting actions. Phase 5 planned.
